rationale_bullets: Brad Jackson returns (470 snaps 79.2 -> 78.2 SBC-adj; BOLD) - an elite dual-threat: 3,224 pass / 21 TD (71%) + 744 rush / 17 TD.
'Kinne will finally have the same starter for consecutive seasons'; both magazines call Jackson 'one of the Pac-12's top QBs'.
78.2 adj maps ABOVE the Maryland-p50 line (~QB p68), plus the dual-threat production - the round's best QB room.
58: well above the proven-G5-starter tier (Hawai'i 38); below the P4-p75 rail. M on elite, settled tape.
data_gaps: only one year as the starter

rationale_bullets: Loses the workhorse Pare (1,128 yds, yr4) but Burrell returns (100 att 86.3 -> 84.3 SBC-adj; 671 @ 6.7 - elite efficiency) as the lead + KR Jenkins (withdrawal override) + Burgess.
In a RUN p87 / RBLK p76 scheme - 'Kinne always produces a 1,000-yд rusher' (PS).
A high-grade, high-efficiency returning back in an elite run system, but the proven 210-att volume (Pare) is gone.
46: above Illinois RB 32 on Burrell + scheme; below Boise 50 on the lost workhorse volume.

THE only FBS program with two 1,000-yд receivers in 2025 - Sparks (1,200; 78.8 SBC-adj; BOLD) + Dawn (1,007; 73.6; BOLD) - both return as seniors. + TE Blake Smith (58.3; BOLD) + transfers D.Jackson (MSU), Z.Sample (ASU).
Two genuine 72+ receivers returning - the Houston-WRTE '2 at 72+' shape - exceptional for G5; the near-zero SBC-WR offset keeps the grades intact.
Capped below the P4 exemplars by a thinner TE room + RECV p40 as-played.
54: above Nebraska WRTE 50 on the two 1,000-yд receivers; well below Houston 78 (P4 + deeper).
PBLK p92 (elite pass pro). Keeps Burns (LT, 68.3 adj; BOLD) + DeLeon (C, 66.8) but loses Strawn (75.6, yr4) + Riker (C -> Penn State) + Lockette (-> Maryland) + Obigbo/Moeolo (yr4).
Rebuilt with P4 transfers: Early (Missouri), R.Jackson (TCU), Boone (UNC) + Schultz/Badusi.
An elite-PBLK line (near-zero SBC offset) keeping 2 starters + a well-sourced P4-transfer rebuild - Kinne OLs are a strength - but three new starters.
44: above the WKU-25 rail on the pedigree + transfer quality; below the p50 line on three new starters.
data_gaps: lost the best OL grade (Strawn, yr4)

rationale_bullets: The elite pass rush (PRSH p96) is GUTTED - 'lose 6 DL' (PS): T.Jackson (76.6, none), Alexander (68.7, none), Snyder (74.4, yr4), Sanders (77.6 -> FSU), Woods (74.2 -> Clemson), K.Washington (70.8 -> Baylor).
Keeps Russell (58.4 adj) + Collins (65.4) + Carter (55.5; BOLD, override) + adds Woody (ULM), Owens (Arizona 75.3), Bradford (McNeese), James (Arkansas).
A near-total rebuild of a unit that WAS elite - three of its best went to P4 programs; the harsh SBC-DL offset (-6.50) deepens the drop.
30: near the p10-25 tier - Collins + Owens the upside; a gutted, unproven rebuild. L.

Loses the best LB Payne (77.8, yr4) + Boudoin (yr4) + C.Johnson (-> North Texas).
Two solid returners + Kinne's 'best LB group since year one' (PS), but lost the standout (Payne) and the SBC-LB offset (-8.20) is brutal.
32: below the UNLV-40 tier - solid returners dragged by the harsh SBC-LB adjustment + the lost standout.
Keeps two good returners - Nolan (S, 72.1 adj; BOLD, withdrawal override, '#2 tackler') + Royal (CB, 69.3) - + Atwood (55.5; BOLD) + C.Jones (62.3) + transfers Ricks (Liberty), Smith (CSU), Moore.
Loses Terrell (-> Wazzu), Mynatt (-> JMU), Rios (74.2, yr4), Crosby (none).
Better retention than the front - Nolan + Royal are proven - but the base was COV p39 (a weak pass D) and it lost 5 DBs (PS).

KR Jenkins led the SBC (27.0, 100-yд TD) + PR Sparks - a genuine return-game strength. SPEC p44.
A solid-if-unproven new kicker + a freshman punter - ST driven by specialists + returners (calib) - middling with a return-game asset.
42: average - the elite KR the differentiator; the new K/P unproven.
